name: Haus Haas Maria
beschreibung:
The Gasthof Haus Haas Maria is located in Neustift im Stubaital and is characterized by a traditional, family atmosphere. The quiet location in the valley is suitable as a starting point for excursions throughout the entire Stubaital.

The accommodation offers simply and comfortably furnished rooms, some with a balcony and views of the surrounding mountains. The hotel's own restaurant serves regional Tiroler specialties. The surrounding area invites you to hiking, cycling tours and, in winter, to skiing at the Stubaier Gletscher. The special character of the house is shaped by alpine coziness and personal service.
